plan.name: v1.9.2-bridge-fee-endblock
plan.info: Bridge fee distribution moved to EndBlock for stable gas usage

title: Upgrade: v1.9.2-bridge-fee-endblock
summary:
This upgrade moves bridge fee distribution from inline (in MsgBridgeAttestMinted) to EndBlock processing.

Problem Solved:
- MsgBridgeAttestMinted gas usage was unpredictable: the attestation that crosses the threshold triggered expensive fee distribution, while earlier attestations used minimal gas
- This caused out-of-gas failures when simulation couldn't predict which attestation would cross the threshold

Changes:
- Fee distribution now happens in EndBlock, making attestation gas stable and predictable
- Added FeeDistributed flag to BridgeMintAttestation for idempotent retries
- Added ConfirmedBy field to track which validator crossed the threshold (receives dust)
- EndBlock fee processing never halts the chain - errors are logged and retried next block
- Orchestrator gas buffer reduced from 1.6x to 1.2x (now safe)
- Orchestrator now verifies tx execution after broadcast (catches DeliverTx failures)

Backward Compatibility:
- Pre-upgrade attestations without ConfirmedBy use fallback (highest-power attestor gets dust)
- No state migration required - new keys are created on first use

BINARY REQUIREMENT: All validators must update to the v1.9.2 binary BEFORE the upgrade height.
